title: Lumbar spine MRI without contrast
source_name: SYNTHETIC - authored for SynthPA-60, modelled on commercial medical policy bulletin structure. Not transcribed from any published payer policy.

required.R1: Low back pain documented for at least 6 weeks
required.R2: Completed at least 4 weeks of supervised physical therapy without adequate relief

any_of.A2: Red flag features present (unexplained weight loss, fever, history of malignancy, or bowel or bladder dysfunction)

exclusions.X1: Lumbar MRI of the same region performed within the previous 6 months with no interval change in symptoms

title: Total knee arthroplasty
source_name: SYNTHETIC - authored for SynthPA-60, modelled on commercial medical policy bulletin structure. Not transcribed from any published payer policy.

required.R1: Radiographic evidence of advanced osteoarthritis (Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3 or 4)
required.R2: Failed conservative management for at least 3 months including NSAIDs and physical therapy
required.R3: Documented functional limitation affecting activities of daily living

exclusions.X1: Active infection of the joint or of an adjacent surgical site
exclusions.X2: Body mass index of 45 or greater without documented weight management plan

title: Brain MRI with contrast
source_name: SYNTHETIC - authored for SynthPA-60, modelled on commercial medical policy bulletin structure. Not transcribed from any published payer policy.

required.R1: Documented neurological sign or symptom prompting evaluation

any_of.A1: New onset headache accompanied by a focal neurological deficit
any_of.A2: Headache refractory to at least 3 months of standard preventive therapy
any_of.A3: Clinical suspicion of intracranial mass with supporting examination findings

exclusions.X1: Study requested solely for routine surveillance in an asymptomatic patient

title: Lumbar spinal fusion, single level
source_name: SYNTHETIC - authored for SynthPA-60, modelled on commercial medical policy bulletin structure. Not transcribed from any published payer policy.

required.R1: Radiographic confirmation of spondylolisthesis or segmental instability at the operative level
required.R2: Failed at least 6 months of non-operative management including physical therapy
required.R3: Concordant symptoms correlating with the imaged level

exclusions.X1: Active nicotine use without documented cessation counselling
exclusions.X2: Untreated osteoporosis with T-score below negative 2.5

title: Roux-en-Y gastric bypass
source_name: SYNTHETIC - authored for SynthPA-60, modelled on commercial medical policy bulletin structure. Not transcribed from any published payer policy.

required.R1: Body mass index of 40 or greater, or 35 or greater with an obesity related comorbidity
required.R2: Documented participation in a supervised weight management programme for at least 6 consecutive months
required.R3: Preoperative psychological evaluation completed and clearance documented

exclusions.X2: Pregnancy, current or planned within 12 months

title: Attended polysomnography in a sleep laboratory
source_name: SYNTHETIC - authored for SynthPA-60, modelled on commercial medical policy bulletin structure. Not transcribed from any published payer policy.

required.R1: Documented symptoms of sleep disordered breathing such as habitual snoring, witnessed apnoea, or excessive daytime sleepiness

any_of.A1: Comorbid condition making home sleep apnoea testing unreliable, such as heart failure, chronic lung disease, or neuromuscular disease
any_of.A2: Prior home sleep apnoea test that was technically inadequate or negative despite persistent symptoms

exclusions.X1: Study requested solely for evaluation of insomnia without features of sleep disordered breathing

title: Continuous positive airway pressure device
source_name: SYNTHETIC - authored for SynthPA-60, modelled on commercial medical policy bulletin structure. Not transcribed from any published payer policy.

required.R1: Diagnostic sleep study completed within the previous 12 months

title: Total hip arthroplasty
